youtube_title: LaPorte, Indiana: Belle Gunness, Part 9 – the brother who came looking (1908)
youtube:
Her letters brought him to LaPorte, Indiana. He never came home. Andrew Helgelien, a Norwegian farmer in South Dakota, got about 80 letters from Belle Gunness telling him to change his money into bills and keep it a secret. In January 1908 he came to her farm, his money was drawn from a LaPorte bank, and he was gone. His brother Asle didn't believe her when she said Andrew had left. After her farmhouse burned on April 28, 1908, Asle came to LaPorte, went to the sheriff, and dug with the hired man and others where garbage had been buried. There he found his brother. It was only the beginning. Comment your town for the next LaPorte After Dark! #LaPorte #LaPorteIndiana #BelleGunness #TrueCrime #History #LaPorteAfterDark #Shorts
